name: sizzle
tagline: The fastest path from credentialed to paid.

segments.text: Credentialing runs on spreadsheets and phone calls. Lanyard Health puts all of it in one place.
Every provider and every payer, live, from the moment you log in.
Ask what needs attention. It answers from your data, with next steps.
Every application in flight, on one board.
A payer catalog of thousands keeps your records clean.
Add a practice straight from the federal registry.
Providers onboard themselves, and CAQH fills in the rest.
Expirations are tracked, and reminders go out before payers notice.
And soon: agents that fill out payer applications, with your approval on every submission.
Lanyard Health. The fastest path from credentialed to paid.
